---
title: "About"
---

I'm a data science leader working across statistics, machine learning, healthcare strategy, and operations. I lead a team of four data scientists and stay hands-on as a player-coach: I set direction, mentor the team, and turn technically demanding work into clear, useful decisions.

My core work is forecasting, causal inference, classification, and decision support in a large healthcare system. I'm extending it into modern AI and machine learning, and the projects on this site are where that shows up.

## How I work

- **Insight that influences decisions.** Creative statistical approaches, automated reporting, and interactive data stories aimed at strategic problem solving.
- **Clear commitments.** Defined deliverables and timelines, with frequent, plain-language communication.
- **Teaching as part of the job.** I mentor data scientists at work and teach statistics and data analysis at the university level.
